product_overview: Goat Goat is a comprehensive Flutter marketplace app for meat and livestock trading, featuring dual-mode mobile portals for customers and sellers, integrated with a Supabase backend and Odoo ERP system, aimed at a secure, scalable, and real-time trading experience.
core_goals: Provide reliable phone-based OTP authentication with developer bypass.
Enable seller product management with approval workflows and Odoo ERP synchronization.
Offer customers a seamless shopping experience with catalog browsing, cart management, and order placement.
Equip admins with robust observability, moderation, and control capabilities through a dedicated web admin panel.
Maintain security with Row Level Security policies, API key protections, audit trails, and MFA for admins.
Ensure zero-risk implementation patterns for stable deployments and backward compatibility.
key_features: OTP-based phone authentication with 5-minute expiry, rate limiting, and developer bypass.
Seller product CRUD with advanced filtering, approval enforcement, and real-time Odoo sync.
Customer product catalog filtered by approval and active status with real-time cart management.
Order infrastructure enabling order placement and future order history features.
Admin panel with traffic monitoring, webhook logs, feature flags, notification management, and RBAC-enabled MFA authentication.
Notification sending via SMS (Fast2SMS) and push (FCM) respecting user preferences.
Google Maps integration for address management and delivery estimation.
Comprehensive audit and logging for security and compliance.
user_flow_summary: Customer logs in via OTP, session persisted across app refreshes, and accesses the customer portal.
Customer browses approved and active meat and livestock products, manages a shopping cart, and places orders.
Seller logs in via OTP, accesses product management to create, edit, or delete products, with critical edits triggering re-approval workflows.
Seller’s product changes sync in real-time with Odoo ERP and updated statuses synchronize back.
Admin logs into the Flutter web admin panel, monitors traffic, moderates reviews, manages notifications and feature flags, and audits system operations.
Notification workflows send OTP and order updates via SMS and push notifications respecting customer preferences.
validation_criteria: OTP delivery and verification success with developer bypass functioning.
Only approved products are activated; edits to critical fields trigger re-approval and deactivation.
Shopping cart operations are stable with RLS enforcing data isolation per customer.
Real-time Odoo sync endpoints respond within SLAs and maintain status consistency.
Admin panel features like traffic logs, feature flags, and moderation are fully operational with RBAC and MFA enforced.
Notifications respect per-customer preferences and log deliveries accurately.
Deployment includes admin build with the correct target and verified webhook API key protections.
Performance metrics meet set thresholds: API response ≤500ms, admin page load ≤2s, 99.9% uptime, and real-time sync latency ≤1s.
